experimental_unit: one real-world PDF classified by pdf-inspector

controlled_variables.population: the operator's curated Zotero library: ~/Zotero/storage/**/*.pdf, de-duplicated by content sha256
controlled_variables.classifier: pdf-inspector via omrg.integrations.pdf registry, instantiated directly
controlled_variables.gate_function: omrg.integrations.pdf.ocr_routing.ocr_required_by_gate — the production function, not a reimplementation
controlled_variables.no_ocr: no worker is started, no model is loaded, no network call is made, nothing is embedded or ingested

ground_truth_definition.label: needs_ocr_truth
ground_truth_definition.basis: the committed CC0 journal pages in tests/fixtures/pdf_baseline/evaluation carry 3,934 and 4,150 characters for one page each; 100 characters per page is under 3% of that, so a document below it has no usable text layer by any reading
ground_truth_definition.sensitivity_analysis: the same counts recomputed at 50 and 200 characters per page, reported as exploratory and never gating

gate_freeze.foreknowledge_of_data: Authors have observed a DIFFERENT dataset: the eight synthetic and rasterised fixtures in tests/fixtures/pdf_baseline, whose classifications are committed in its manifest.json and in experiment 24. NO document in the Zotero library has been classified by pdf-inspector, and no aggregate over it has been computed. The gates below are derived from the fixture evidence and from a power analysis, never from the population under study.

baseline_evidence.fast_path_cost: experiment 24 output/ablation.json — 0.001 to 1.01 s per fast-path file
baseline_evidence.ocr_cost: ocr-worker/SMOKE_RESULTS.md — 33.7 to 106.4 s per page warm, 150.8 to 289.8 s cold including model load

validity_gates.definition: documents with needs_ocr_truth == false that the candidate gate routes to OCR
validity_gates.scope: every de-duplicated document in the population
validity_gates.basis: experiment 24 froze altered_fast_path_outputs == 0 on the same principle. A false route costs 33.7-106.4 s per page against a fast path of about 1 s per file, a 30x to 100x regression on a document that needed nothing. Any non-zero count means the packaged default would impose that regression on documents unasked.

validity_gates.scope: every de-duplicated document in the population
validity_gates.basis: power analysis at the realised n. At n=83 the smallest observed count whose Wilson 95% interval separates the prevalence from 1% is 3 documents (3.6%). Below that this study cannot distinguish a real need for OCR from noise, and a packaged default that serves an unresolvable minority is risk without demonstrated benefit.

monitored_non_gating.definition: routed page count x 106.4 s (the committed warm worst case), reported in minutes and as a multiple of the fast-path time for the same corpus
monitored_non_gating.reason: the number the promotion decision needs, but the acceptable figure is an operator preference and cannot be derived from the evidence, so it is reported rather than gated

monitored_non_gating.definition: counts of pdf_type, the confidence distribution, and the flagged-page proportion distribution
monitored_non_gating.reason: describes the population and shows how close the corpus sits to the 0.5 thresholds; no pre-specified expectation exists to gate against

monitored_non_gating.definition: documents routed with the thresholds at the 0.0 never-trigger sentinels, isolating the unconditional pdf_type rule from the calibrated thresholds
monitored_non_gating.reason: attributes any routing to the classifier or to the calibration; diagnostic, not a promotion criterion

decision_rule.promote_switch_true: safety gate passes AND benefit gate passes
decision_rule.promote_thresholds_only: safety gate passes AND benefit gate fails — the calibrated values are demonstrably harmless on this population but there is nothing to gain by default
decision_rule.promote_nothing: safety gate fails — under no reading does a default that mis-routes real documents belong in a packaged release
decision_rule.note: This experiment can only speak for the population it sampled: one operator's curated academic library. It cannot license a default for corpora it never saw, and the change record must say so.
